run_loader_game: run the Loader class to initialize a reduced service game loop with minirts and callback registration
run_reduced_service_loop: run the reduced service game loop by calling initialize_reduced_service and iterating GC.Run for nIter steps
review_loader_class: review the Loader class that extends CommonLoader to define args, actor spec, train spec, and reduced specs
review_on_gc_method: review the _on_gc method that configures MCExtractorOptions and MCExtractorUsageOptions on the game controller
review_reduced_specs: review the _get_reduced_predict, _get_reduced_forward, and _get_reduced_project methods that define reduced state specs
